units.Description: Physical unit. The release channel tables list the ECoG units as 'unscaled' for 12 of the 13 participants (values as exported from the acquisition system, scale factor not given); these are written as n/a here and as 'unscaled' in the BrainVision header. sub-02 is in microvolts (release: uV).

notch.Description: Notch filter range as listed in the release channel table (Hz); n/a when the release lists 0 or nothing

low_cutoff.Description: High-pass cutoff (Hz) as listed in the release channel table; n/a when blank

high_cutoff.Description: Low-pass cutoff (Hz) as listed in the release channel table; n/a when blank

status_description.Description: Status description from the release channel table ('keep for referencing'), or a converter note

analysis_region.Description: Gyrus assigned to this channel in the release montage file (the channels analysed by Miles et al. 2025: MFG, PrCG, PoCG, SMG, STG, MTG); n/a for channels not in the montage file
